in_sanskrit.name: भार्तिहरि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the Lord ( Bharta ) and Hari ( Vishnu ).

in_hindi.name: भार्तिहरि
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is the Lord ( Bharta, husband or lover ) and Hari ( Vishnu, the preserver of the universe ).

in_tamil.name: பார்திஹாரி
in_tamil.meaning: பார்த்தர் (ஆத்மா, ஆத்மவிட்டம்) + ஹாரி (ஹரி, ஹிங்கல் ஹிஜ் ஹிஜை)
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is the Lord ( Bharthar, self or God ) and Hari ( Hari, the god of the river Cauvery or a form of Lord Shiva ).

in_telugu.name: భార్తిహారి
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the Lord ( Bhartah, husband or lover ) and Hari ( Hari, Heshapresh or Heshvar, the preserver of the universe ).

in_marathi.name: Bhartihari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhartihari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bharti means 'to reside' and Hari means 'God, Lord Vishnu'. Bhartihari refers to the one who resides on the earth as the divine being. He is also known as Bhartrihari, a great sage in Hindu mythology.

in_bengali.name: Bhartihari
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Earth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhartihari একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bharti means 'to reside' and Hari means 'God, Lord Vishnu'. Bhartihari refers to the one who resides on the earth as the divine being. He is also known as Bhartrihari, a great sage in Hindu mythology.
